macro_dynamics.pattern_mechanics:
A pattern is a closed circuit, and that is what makes it different from a list of aspects.

Three or more bodies in mutual aspect stop behaving as separate placements and start behaving as one unit: a transit to any member lights all of them. That is why the figure is read as a thing in itself, and why it is held to physical bodies at a tight orb - the points can be aspected but do not close a circuit, and a loose contact does not weaken the resonance so much as stop it existing.
macro_dynamics.pattern_tsquare:
Two bodies in opposition, both square a third: the apex takes the strain of both.

Two squares demanding action and one opposition demanding awareness, all landing on one planet, which acts as the lightning rod. It is the most motivating figure in a chart and the least comfortable. The apex is where the pressure is felt and where the work gets done.
macro_dynamics.pattern_grandcross:
Four bodies, four squares, two oppositions: pulled in four directions at once.

The Saturnian make-or-break figure, and the one most often described as carrying the weight of the world. Integrated, it is an unmatched structural foundation - concentration, endurance and the self-made will to put an ideal into concrete form. Unintegrated, it is simply four-way stress with no empty leg to discharge through.
macro_dynamics.pattern_grandtrine:
Three bodies at 120 degrees: a closed circuit of self-sufficiency.

Noel Tyl's phrase, and the warning is in it. The energy circulates without resistance, so the talent is real, automatic and almost always taken for granted. Nothing in the figure requires anything of you, which is why an unaspected grand trine tends to produce ease rather than achievement.
macro_dynamics.pattern_kite:
A grand trine with somewhere to put itself.

A fourth body opposite one corner, sextile to the other two, gives the closed circuit an exit. The single opposition is the grit in the oyster: just enough friction and objectivity to make the flowing talent productive. A kite is a far more accomplished figure than the grand trine inside it.
macro_dynamics.pattern_yod:
Two bodies in easy sextile, both quincunx a third that can reconcile neither.

The apex is held at 150 degrees from both ends of a cooperative base, and a quincunx has no common ground of element, mode or polarity to compromise on. The result is a chronic, subliminal adjustment and a characteristic crisis of timing - reacting too fast on one leg and too slowly on the other.
macro_dynamics.pattern_boomerang:
A Yod with the missing perspective supplied.

A fourth body sits opposite the apex, on the midpoint of the sextile base, and gives the figure the objective axis a Yod lacks. The guesswork and the bad timing come out of it: the abstract pressure of the two quincunxes gets grounded and spent on something concrete.
macro_dynamics.pattern_mysticrectangle:
Two oppositions boxed in by trines and sextiles - tension with the resolution built in.

Despite the name it is a soft figure. It generates no raw friction and no urge to fight; what it supplies is an unusually stable baseline, because the easy aspects hand the oppositions a ready-made route to integration. Balanced under load rather than driven.
macro_dynamics.pattern_grandsextile:
Six bodies at 60 degrees: two grand trines, six kites, three mystic rectangles, and almost no friction at all.

Exceptionally rare and almost entirely self-contained. Every body is bound to every other by soft aspect, so stress applied anywhere is diffused instantly across the whole grid. The figure seeks equilibrium rather than achievement, which is the cost of having no hard angle anywhere in it.
macro_dynamics.pattern_cradle:
Three linked sextiles spanning an opposition or a trine: a chain of easy steps.

Each body hands on to the next, so difficulty at one end can be walked round rather than confronted. It is a supportive figure and a mildly evasive one.
macro_dynamics.tsquare_cardinal:
A cardinal T-square starts things and starts them at speed.

Active, impatient and goal-driven, with the crises arriving in the angular arenas - identity, home, partnership, career. The correction it asks for is Libran: moderation, timing, and a willingness to compromise rather than initiate again.
macro_dynamics.tsquare_fixed:
A fixed T-square endures, and then it detonates.

Determined, slow-moving and immensely persistent under pressure, with the danger in the same qualities: stubbornness, stagnation and feeling kept in until it periodically goes off. What it has to learn is flexibility and letting go, neither of which is native to it.
macro_dynamics.tsquare_mutable:
A mutable T-square adapts until there is nothing left to hold on to.

Versatile, restless and heavily shaped by whoever is around, with the apex prone to scattering and vacillation. The work is to build a central, anchoring purpose, because the figure will otherwise be pulled in every direction offered to it.
macro_dynamics.grandcross_cardinal:
A cardinal grand cross is a windmill: enormous output, and no reserve tank.

It turns hard whenever anything triggers it and is capable of sudden, disproportionate effort. The risk is running on empty to the point of physical exhaustion, along with a head-on insistence on doing it alone.
macro_dynamics.grandcross_fixed:
A fixed grand cross does not move until something breaks it.

Monumental will, endurance and staying power, spent on holding a position. Change is resisted until a crisis large enough to collapse the defences arrives, at which point the same endurance rebuilds from the floor.
macro_dynamics.grandcross_mutable:
A mutable grand cross ducks.

Chronic vacillation and worry, and an instinct to slip aside rather than meet a conflict directly. Highly attuned to what everyone else is thinking, and prone to scattering into distractions rather than choosing one of the four directions.
macro_dynamics.grandtrine_fire:
A fire grand trine burns freely and does not refuel.

Dynamic, enthusiastic and quick to act, with joy and anger both arriving at full volume. The discipline it never develops on its own is conserving the fuel.
macro_dynamics.grandtrine_earth:
An earth grand trine makes the material world easy and then will not leave it.

Grounded, practical, sensual and materially fortunate: resources arrive and stay. The hazard is comfort - a deep attachment to routine and security, and real resistance to anything that disturbs either.
macro_dynamics.grandtrine_air:
An air grand trine can think about anything except doing it.

Intellectual, objective, sociable and endlessly fluent across ideas. The talent is genuine and the missing element is execution: the circuit is complete without ever touching the ground.
macro_dynamics.grandtrine_water:
A water grand trine feels everything and can arrange to feel more.

Emotionally alive, deeply intuitive and highly compassionate, with a strong pull toward dependency. At its least conscious it generates its own drama, because the familiar rush of intense feeling is the circuit doing what it does.
macro_dynamics.pattern_dissociate:
The figure holds by degree while the signs disagree.

Its members are not all in one modality or element, so it is a dissociate pattern: the geometry is there and the tidy sign-based description of it is not. Read the degrees, and expect it to behave a little off the textbook.
